Canadian PM Mark Carney:
Earlier today, I paid my respects at Anıtkabir, where Türkiye honours the founder of this Republic, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk.
And the monument is surrounded by a peace park. And in the years following the Second World War, nations from around the world, including Canada, sent trees to grow side by side.
And today, that park stands as a living symbol of friendship between nations, a shared hope for peace. And it reminds us that the strongest partnerships take root over time.
And they are nourished by mutual respect, by steady commitment, and by common purpose.
And today, that purpose matters more than ever.

Canadian PM Mark Carney on Türkiye:
Canada is building deeper partnerships with reliable partners that create new opportunities for us both. And in Türkiye, we have an exceptional partner.

Canadian PM Mark Carney:
At the end of one world order, Mustafa Kemal Atatürk built a secure, sovereign nation guided by his creed: “Peace at home, peace in the world.”
And in this time of rupture, Canada honours that example: strength at home, partnership abroad.
Mr. President, more than 70 years ago, Canada sent maple trees to grow beside and in Anıtkabir as a gesture of peace and friendship between our nations.
Today, those trees stand amongst 48,000 others from over 25 nations.
Today, we planted the seeds of something new: a strategic partnership that will create new opportunities for our workers and our businesses, and greater security and prosperity for both our peoples, and, with our efforts, I believe, for other peoples in this region and more broadly.
With care and commitment, that partnership will grow for generations to come.

حووسییەکان: لە 48 کاتژمێردا چوار هێرشی بەرفراوانمان کردووەتە سەر سعوودیە
 حووسییەکانی یەمەن ڕایانگەیاند، لە ماوەی 48 کاتژمێری ڕابردوودا بە مووشەکی بالیستی و فڕۆکەی بێفڕۆکەوان، چوار ئۆپەراسیۆنی سەربازییان لەناو خاکی سعوودیە ئەنجامداوە.
 بەپێی ڕاگەیەندراوی گرووپەکە، ئامانجی هێرشەکان بریتی بوون لە:  
• بینای وەزارەتی بەرگریی سعوودیە لە شاری ڕیاز  
• فڕۆکەخانەی نێودەوڵەتی لە شاری دەمام  
• دامەزراوە نەوتییەکانی کۆمپانیای ئارامکۆ لە یەنبەع  
• فڕۆکەخانەی نێودەوڵەتیی ئەبها  
 حووسییەکان جەختیان کردەوە کە ئەم هێرشانە وەک وەڵامێکە بۆ بۆردومانەکانی سعوودیە، هۆشداریشیان دا کە لە لێدانی ئامانجە ستراتیژییەکان لە قوڵایی خاکی سعوودیەدا بەردەوام دەبن.
